summaryZh: Meyers 实验室研究用人工智能改进和自动化放射治疗，重点发展宫颈癌近距离放疗的全自动计划。
methods: 基于知识的自动化计划

evidence.quote: Dr. Sandra Meyers Dr. Meyers’ lab focuses on the use of AI for improving and automating aspects of radiation treatment. One major effort is the development and implementation of a fully-automated (knowledge-based) planning approach in patients undergoing brachytherapy, particularly in women with cervical cancer. Her work is complementary to that of other RMAS researchers who are focused on developing and clinically implementing automated planning in patients treated with intensity-modulated radiotherapy (IMRT) and conventional 3D conformal radiotherapy (3DCRT). Support Dr. Meyers’ research is supported in part by a 5-year, $1.2M K08 grant from the National Cancer Institute of the National Institute of Health​. Explore the Lab People Discover the brilliant minds in Dr. Sandra Meyers' lab, dedicated to pioneering advancements in radiation medicine. Meet Our Team Publications Dive into the cutting-edge research coming out of Dr. Sandra Meyers' lab.
